summary: loader-utils-kit: typosquat of loader-utils with obfuscated Function-constructor payload
details: Package name resembles the popular webpack 'loader-utils' and ships copies of its genuine source files alongside a non-upstream file lib/contract.js. lib/contract.js assigns the host's require and module to global via scrambled string lookups, then uses a deterministic char-shuffle routine to reconstruct the string 'constructor', obtains the Function constructor from a function reference, builds a new Function from another decoded string, and invokes it (`whk(YOB, ype(LEF)); cMp(7746)`). The resulting function is exported as `.contract` and is called from `chain(chai, utils)` in lib/index.js, so requiring the package triggers execution of the opaque decoded payload with full access to require/module. The obfuscation layer (char-permutation decoder, scrambled property access, numeric indices into reconstructed strings) has no connection to the advertised webpack loader-utility purpose and serves only to hide a dynamically constructed code path from static review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
